test_cases.prompt: Grill me on my talk outline.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-me skill (stateless) to stress-test the talk outline through grilling rounds.
test_cases.notes: Conference talk prep is a key trigger for stateless grilling.

test_cases.prompt: Stress-test my plan for the migration.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-me skill to run grilling primitive on migration plan without creating artifacts.
test_cases.notes: Plan sharpening is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Interview me about this job offer.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-me skill to run rounds on growth, culture, compensation, location decisions.
test_cases.notes: Career decision is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Grill me on this design, but save the decisions to CONTEXT.md.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill instead. Grill-with-docs is stateful and creates CONTEXT.md/ADRs; grill-me is stateless.
test_cases.notes: grill-with-docs is the sibling skill for stateful grilling.

test_cases.prompt: Help me decide on the architecture for this module.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Could be grill-me (stateless) or grill-with-docs (stateful). Depends on whether user is in a working directory.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: architecture decision could use either skill.

test_cases.prompt: This test is failing. Help me debug it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill instead. Diagnosing-bugs finds root cause; grill-me sharpens thinking.
test_cases.notes: diagnosing-bugs is the sibling skill for debugging.

test_cases.prompt: I'm not in a repo. Help me think through this business strategy.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-me skill for stateless thinking when no working directory exists. Edge case: business strategy is outside typical engineering scope but valid for stateless grilling.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: no-repo non-engineering topic tests grill-me's applicability beyond code.
